# Matt Mazur

> > A SaaS founder's portfolio showcasing 13+ years of bootstrapped business growth, poker strategy tools, and technical insights on indie entrepreneurship.

Matt Mazur documents his journey building Preceden (timeline software) and other SaaS projects, sharing detailed business metrics, founder stories, and technical deep-dives. The site covers both entrepreneurship and poker strategy, reflecting diverse interests in business optimization and game theory.

## Key Topics

- Preceden
- Indie SaaS
- Bootstrapped Growth
- Entrepreneurship
- Revenue Growth
- ALL IN Expert
- Poker Strategy
- No Limit Hold'em
- Expected Value
- ChatGPT API
- Side Projects
- Year in Review
- Business Updates
- Emergent Mind
- Lean Domain Search

## Core & About

- [Matt Mazur](https://mattmazur.com): Homepage featuring Matt Mazur's SaaS projects and business updates

## SaaS & Business

- [Going Full Time on My SaaS After 13 Years | Matt Mazur](https://mattmazur.com/2023/01/04/going-full-time-on-my-saas-after-13-years): Preceden founder story: 13-year journey to full-time SaaS
- [My Indie SaaS Revenue has Grown 37% per Year for 13 Years | Matt Mazur](https://mattmazur.com/2024/01/16/my-indie-saas-revenue-has-grown-37-per-year-for-13-years): Revenue analysis and growth metrics for bootstrapped Preceden
- [2024 Year in Review | Matt Mazur](https://mattmazur.com/2025/01/10/2024-year-in-review): Annual business review of Preceden and indie SaaS ventures
- [It's Time to Build | Matt Mazur](https://mattmazur.com/2024/04/23/its-time-to-build): SaaS business updates on Preceden and Emergent Mind projects
- [Building a Startup in 45 Minutes per day While Deployed to Iraq | Matt Mazur](https://mattmazur.com/2016/01/04/building-a-startup-in-45-minutes-per-day-while-deployed-to-iraq): Founder story: Building Lean Domain Search during military deployment

## Poker Strategy & Tools

- [ALL IN Expert | Matt Mazur](https://mattmazur.com/all-in-expert): Poker software tool for No Limit Hold'em all-in decisions
- [Hold'em or Fold'em? Expected Value for Calling ALL IN | Matt Mazur](https://mattmazur.com/expected-value-for-calling-all-in): Guide to calculating expected value in poker all-in decisions
- [Farha runs KK into Greenstein's AA on High Stakes Poker | Matt Mazur](https://mattmazur.com/farha-vs-greenstein): Poker hand analysis case study from High Stakes Poker
